description: Places an order with paper money. side up buys Higher: it wins if the number finishes above the strike. side down sells: it holds Lower. A win pays 2× size. Leave out strike for a market order.

key.description: Your rz_ API key, if this server has no bearer token set.

strike.description: Makes it a limit order, on the market’s strike grid

tif.description: gtc (rests), ioc (takes what it can) or post (only ever rests)

name: place_order
